name: Light and patchy
notes: Wind model #10: 6-9 kn, oscillation +/-10 deg, no persistent trend; sparse, strong (+35 %) puffs and many lulls. #221 overrides #10's 150-180 s period with about 100 s, the slowest of the four.
Units: knots, degrees, seconds, metres; gains, losses, shares, coverage and drift as fractions.

Version 2 (schema 2, #75) is version 1 plus the keyed wind's wobble: wobbleDegrees is the peak of the smaller, faster wobble (#10) each 30 s window's key draws on top of the oscillation, vanishing at the window's knots. Strength is fixed for the race (#10), so there is no strength-channel tuning.

Version 3 (#221, #233) is version 2 with only three values changed: the period 90-110 s (was 150-180 s), the wobble 2.5 deg (was 1 deg), readable but never outlasting its 30 s window, and the puff fan 7.5 deg (was 5 deg), about 1.5 x, so a puff can decide which tack is favoured. The amplitude and every other puff column are unchanged.

Placeholders (JSON Pointers above) await tuning on the #232 sliders: the 90-110 s period, the 2.5 deg wobble and the 7.5 deg fan (#221 says about 2-3 deg and 7-8 deg), and the other puff columns, set from #10's words (sparse, strong, many lulls) and its shared ranges (60-150 m, puffs +20-35 %, lulls -15-25 %, drift 0.3-0.5 x wind).
